patch_description: This redesign uses a modular multi-start nonlinear packing pipeline instead of a single lattice optimization. It builds several staggered and asymmetric row layouts, perturbs them deterministically, optimizes each candidate using analytic constraint Jacobians, repairs floating-point feasibility safely, and then performs a longer polishing pass on the best candidates. Squared-distance contact constraints and vectorized derivatives improve optimizer efficiency while the candidate pool helps escape the previous symmetric 2.50 local optimum.
